# Gramlot 0.3.33

## Charts

- New `gauge` element: one value as a needle dial, a ring or an arc, with
  range, thresholds, mask and caption.
- New chart types on the ECharts engine: funnel, radar, parallel, heatmap,
  sankey, candlestick, boxplot, treemap and sunburst.
- One element per chart type (for example `chartCandlestick`) with its roles as
  attributes; `chartView` keeps `chartType`.
- Every chart type declares its syntax; one syntax check reports errors as
  `ChartSyntaxError`. A chart without measures is a syntax error.
- A chart that cannot be drawn shows an icon, one line and "More info" instead
  of an empty area. The chart configurator follows the syntax of each type.
- The charts guide (480-charts) documents the elements, the syntax and the
  rules of the new types.

## PageStore

- A page with a PageStore inside an iframe whose parent declares no PageStore
  (for example a plain page with tabs) opens its own WebSocket instead of
  closing. A parent with a different endpoint still fails.

## Collection generator

- `gramlot-builder` accepts Node 22 or later; before, only the 22, 24 and 26
  lines were accepted.
